patch.scope: Isolated same-shape wide F32 row copy experiment. Width 0 keeps the existing dispatch; widths 1,4,8 explicitly opt in. Strided rows preserve all source and destination strides. Unaligned vectors and different shapes fall back. No model, cache, rollback or launcher default changes. Separate conv-direct mode skips an intermediate contiguous tensor before the existing strided copy; all rollback slots remain.
